title: The Vigil of the Dawn
summary: A level-50 Paladin story, personal chapters and Chapterhouse rewards.
body:
Live testing

Deployed October 23 for live testing. Automated native, content and cache checks passed. Full encounters, client-visible behavior and owner balance acceptance remain open.

Camil’s vigil

The route starts with Camil in East Commonlands at level 50, with Paladin in any held class slot. A Keeper near Befallen in West Commonlands opens a Chapterhouse expedition. The native Tasks window tracks Sered, three memorials, Elowen’s three-wave defense, Halvyr, three bound knights, Vaelen, the Unbroken Shadow and the altar, then return to Camil.

Endgame capstone

The tuning target is a demanding fight for a fully developed level-50 character, including legal undead procs, Slay Undead, Ghoulbane and critical AAs. Reaching level 50 alone does not imply readiness. Sered rewards timely interrupts; Elowen needs protection. Vaelen and the Shadow mark your position with a three-second warning: move more than ten paces or interrupt. Undead bonuses remain effective. Full encounter balance and other strong class combinations still require player testing.

Personal progress

Earned chapters survive reconnects and run resets. Removing the Tasks display does not erase them. Make room for both story and dungeon journals. Eligible nearby participants earn personal credit; later witnesses cannot borrow another player’s kills. The helmet claim survives a full inventory and is delivered once.

Rewards

Ember of the First Dawn retains its published primary/heroic budgets and now adds Healing Amount. Any unowned killable Chapterhouse enemy, including scripted adds, has a1.5% augment roll;60/30/8/2qualities and static-only35% miniboss relic rolls remain. Current reward values.

Classic access

Chapterhouse uses a scoped exception while Classic and level 50 remain global. Its population, spells and rewards are curated; stock Rain of Fear drops are excluded. The waypoint recalls to a public foyer, and the Keeper controls private run admission.

The Ashen Compact — live testing

The Ashen Compact is an installed level-50 Shadow Knight helmet campaign in a curated Kael expedition. Its paired server and client release is available for testing; full encounter, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

This separate Shadow Knight campaign follows the Vigil’s structure. Camil’s progress and helmet entitlement remain independent.

All top-quality augments, drop zones and secondary specialties — live testing; gameplay acceptance remains open.
